payout_quote: Enjoy the flexibility of working when you want, and plan around personal and family needs. Browse nearby shifts, see the pay up front, and book in a tap.
steps: Download the Shiftsmart app and sign up as a Partner.
Open the Shifts tab and browse nearby opportunities with pay shown up front.
Complete any required onboarding for the projects that interest you.
Book shifts that fit your schedule.
Complete the shift tasks; get paid in days, not weeks, per the Partner Terms.
catches: Shift availability varies by area — some regions have little work.
Shift pay is set per listing; you cannot negotiate it.
You work as an independent contractor: no benefits, handle your own taxes.
Shift approval/payment processing can be slow or disputed per worker reports — document your work.
Some shifts have extra requirements shown in the app.
biggest_catch: Availability is area-dependent and pay is take-it-or-leave-it per shift — plus you are on your own for taxes as a contractor.
eligibility: 18+, legally authorized to work in the US, able to read/complete tasks in English, with a smartphone.
timing: Shifts post continuously; paid in days after eligible shift completion.

c1.evidence: Shiftsmart's own page states the mechanism: 'Browse nearby shifts, see the pay up front, and book in a tap' and the help center documents: 'Choose your shifts, build your schedule, and start earning!... After completing your chosen shifts, get paid in days, not weeks!'

c2.evidence: Official terms show pay per shift up front but publish no fixed platform-wide range — framed as variable.

c3.evidence: Steps follow the official flow: sign up, browse shifts, onboard for projects, book, complete, get paid.

c4.evidence: Signup is free; no upfront fee documented.
